_comment: Specific, non-obvious facts (T-01). A model that answers from the general shape of e-commerce policy gets these wrong; only a model that actually read the KB gets them right. probe_question seeds the is_needle scenarios of T-06.

needles.why: the standard 5-8 day estimate is the obvious answer; the extra 5 days for extended-delivery areas is not
needles.probe_question: I live in one of the extended-delivery areas you list at checkout. My order shipped on Monday, when should it arrive?

needles.why: everyone expects the 30-day window of F17; promotional items get 7 days instead
needles.probe_question: I bought a jacket on sale and it was delivered three weeks ago. Can I still exchange it?

needles.why: return shipping being free is the common assumption; only the first exchange of an order is
needles.probe_question: I already exchanged this order once for a bigger size and the size is still wrong. What does another exchange cost me?

needles.why: F26 says cancellation is free before dispatch, so the 24-hour production cut-off for personalised items contradicts the obvious rule
needles.probe_question: I ordered a personalised mug two days ago and it has not shipped yet. Cancel it, please.

needles.why: the number of reissues allowed is arbitrary and cannot be guessed
needles.probe_question: My payment slip expired again. This is the third one I need. Can you issue it?

needles.why: a reissued slip keeping the original promotional price is unusual and cannot be inferred
needles.probe_question: My slip expired and the item costs more now. Will the new slip charge me the new price?
